desc:
📸 Welcome to Hide from Camera or Die! 💀

How to Play:
🏃 Run and find a hiding spot before the camera takes a photo
👀 Stay out of the camera's view to survive
📸 Watch when the camera snaps a picture
💥 Don't get caught
🔥 Survive as the map gets harder every round
🏆 Be the last player standing or survive all 5 rounds
💰 Earn $50 for every round you survive
👑 Get $1,000 per win (divided by survivors)
👊 Slap other players to knock them away
🔥 Unlock stronger hands with better effects
👻 Get eliminated? Spectate and troll the remaining players

💸 Earn more cash:
➕ Invite friends for +25% Cash (max +100%)
🏃 Complete the obby for $250
👥 Join the group for $2,000 every 15 minutes
✨ Buy the 2x Cash Gamepass to double income


Can you hide from the camera and survive all 5 rounds?

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards and future updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players.


👥 Inspired by Hide or Die, Hide or Oof, Spin or Die
